title: single-writer lease blocks Write/Edit but not interpreter writes via Bash
detail: Session 813b2be0: with the lease still held by finished session 375aeb27, three python3 heredoc edits (pathlib write_text to prusik/gate.py, drive.py, consistency.py) went through via Bash; the next Write tool call was refused by the lease gate. Same class as fb-1303f39d14a6 (shared-tree writes no command text names), but on the main-session lease path rather than drive's role spawns. Fix shape: the lease check should key on tree state (fingerprint before/after a Bash call), not on parsed write targets.
